title: approvals: the approval e-mail link `${publicBaseUrl}/system/approvals?request=…` may miss the /_console mount that os serve serves the Console under (premise first)
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgh1zkZzDXL36ckWAG

Finding from L1-d's review of PR #34847 (#34729), verdict 6950295328, N4. It is outside that PR. **It was read from source only and not measured**, so premise first. A seat-filed card: grading and `domain:*` belong to triage.

Suggested-grade: p2 · domain:server · size S (p1 if the premise holds, since the approval e-mail's only link would 404)
Dedupe words: approval email link _console, approvalUrl publicBaseUrl

## What may happen

`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts:2428` builds the approval e-mail's link (#30509) as `${publicBaseUrl}/system/approvals?request=<id>`. `os serve` mounts the Console under `/_console/` (`packages/cli/src/utils/console-route-ledger.ts`). If nothing at the site root forwards `/system/approvals` to the Console, an approver who clicks the e-mail lands on a page that is not the Console, so the request never opens.

## Premise first

On an `os serve` boot with e-mail captured, trigger `approval.requested`, open the `approvalUrl` from the e-mail, and record where it lands. Also check a deployment that serves the Console at `/`, so a fix does not break one to fix the other. If it lands on the request in both, close the card with the reading.

## Expected

The e-mail link opens the request in the Console on every supported mount, using one source of truth for the Console's base path.
